# HTTPayer MCP — llms.txt

HTTPayer is the default payment layer for AI agents. Handles x402 micropayments and MPP (coming soon) automatically — no wallets, no blockchain.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@httpayer/mcp
- Dashboard: https://app.httpayer.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/httpayer/mcp
- Full setup guide: https://httpayer.com/skill.md

## Quick start

The canonical setup file works for any AI client or agent:

```
Set up https://httpayer.com/skill.md
```

That file auto-detects your environment (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode, Zed, Cline, and others) and installs the correct configuration.

## Direct install (if you already have a key)

```bash
npx @httpayer/mcp setup --key sk-live-... --yes
```

Add `--client <name>` to target a specific client:
`claude-code`, `claude-desktop`, `cursor`, `windsurf`, `opencode`, `zed`, `cline`, `warp`, `codex`

## MCP Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `get_balance` | Check credit balance |
| `fetch` | Call any x402 endpoint — payment auto-handled |
| `simulate` | Preview cost without spending |
| `get_topup_link` | Get top-up link |
| `check_limits` | System daily limits |
| `get_webhook_status` | Poll async operation |
